claim.text: Grouped-query attention lets several queries share one key and value, so the KV cache grows with the number of KV heads

spec.explain: Illustrative toy from arXiv 2305.13245 showing grouped queries sharing one key and value blocks; KV cache grows with KV heads, not queries.

} ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h); ctx.fillStyle = "#f6f3ec"; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h); ctx.fillStyle = "#1a1a1a"; ctx.font = "13px sans-serif"; ctx.textAlign = "left"; ctx.textBaseline = "top"; ctx.fillText("Q heads share KV blocks", 24, 12); ctx.fillText("kv_cache = " + fmt(kvheads * seqlen), 300, 12); ctx.fillText("grouping = " + fmt(qheads / kvheads), 470, 12); var i = 0; var g = 0; var bw = 560 / kvheads; var bx = 0; var by = 44; ctx.font = "11px sans-serif"; for (i = 0; i < kvheads; i = i + 1) { bx = 40 + i * bw; ctx.fillStyle = "#c4512c"; ctx.fillRect(bx + 2, by, bw - 4, 26); ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff"; ctx.textAlign = "center"; ctx.fillText("KV", bx + bw / 2, 50); } ctx.strokeStyle = "#c4512c"; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.beginPath(); for (i = 0; i < kvheads; i = i + 1) { bx = 40 + i * bw + bw / 2; ctx.moveTo(bx, 70); ctx.lineTo(bx, 88); } ctx.stroke(); var cols = 16; var qx = 0; var qy = 0; var grp = 0; var gx0 = 0; var gx1 = 0; for (i = 0; i < qheads; i = i + 1) { grp = Math.floor(i * kvheads / qheads); qx = 40 + (i % cols) * 33.5; qy = 94 + Math.floor(i / cols) * 24; gx0 = 40 + grp * bw; gx1 = gx0 + bw; if (grp % 2 === 0) { ctx.fillStyle = "#1f4b99"; } else { ctx.fillStyle = "#2e8b8b"; } ctx.fillRect(qx, qy, 27, 17); ctx.strokeStyle = "#1a1a1a"; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.strokeRect(qx, qy, 27, 17); } var maxCache = 32768; var frac = (kvheads * seqlen) / maxCache; var barMax = 520; var barLen = frac * barMax; var r = 0; ctx.textAlign = "left"; ctx.fillStyle = "#1a1a1a"; ctx.fillText("KV cache rows = KV heads, length = seqlen", 24, 204); for (r = 0; r < kvheads; r = r + 1) { qy = 224 + r * 7; ctx.fillStyle = "#e3d9c2"; ctx.fillRect(80, qy, barMax, 5); ctx.fillStyle = "#c4512c"; ctx.fillRect(80, qy, barLen, 5); } ctx.fillStyle = "#1a1a1a"; ctx.fillText("seqlen", 24, 224); ctx.fillText("clipped", 600, 330); }
